measurement.label: L0-visibility:host-plus-associated
measurement.limits: RSS is a one-second sampled maximum of observed descendants, with 10 ms lifecycle supplements; CPU intervals exclude new, departed or unreadable identities. associatedProcesses.remainingGaps: between-observation process changes, startup before driver connection, unobserved short-lived processes, and any explicit unavailable/permission rows

scope.processCoverage: native descendants and separately measured birth-verified WK instance associations

webkitXpc.method: acceptance-only WebKit instance SPI, birth identity checked by driver and sampler; shared identities deduplicated
webkitXpc.coverage: reported per run; unavailable roles and expired association leases remain gaps

scope.totalApplicationMemoryComparison: no exclusive-cost or improvement claim: associated XPC processes may be shared and incomplete intervals are excluded
scope.watchTiming: missing: reader start/completion are observed; no event-specific filesystem watch timestamp
scope.publication: actual core Publisher acceptance before monitor deduplication; delivery and commit have separate coverage
scope.hidden: native windows remain hidden; acceptance presentation state is explicit and does not change document visibility or native rAF
scope.frames: milliseconds between draws in distinct observed native rAF timestamp buckets; hidden WK may suspend rAF; neither physical presentation nor display refresh rate
scope.webglDraws: original WebGL draw methods returned; synchronous calls coalesced by at most one pending microtask, independent of rAF; not GPU completion or presented frames; run-wide including warmup and mode transitions
scope.bytes: UTF-8 JSON of received event value, excluding Tauri transport envelope; not wire bytes
scope.lifecycle: acceptance command spawn/exit plus verified sampled birth identities; startup before probe install, unseen grandchildren, and sub-poll lifetimes remain missing
scope.readBytes: only reads carrying a fixture correlation key; not all filesystem traffic
